 SECTIONS DA hike: Diwali bonanza for UP govt employees, 63% raise announced; revised rates effective from July 1 ANI Last Updated: Nov 07, 2026, 04:15:00 PM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis The revised allowance will be reflected in the November salary, while the arrears for the preceding four months will be deposited separately into their provident fund accounts. The announcement comes ahead of Diwali, with the revised allowance set to benefit a large section of the state's workforce.
 Agencies UP DA Hike (Image for representation)
 Lucknow: The Uttar Pradesh government, led by Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, has increased the Dearness Allowance ( DA ) for state government employees to 63 per cent, with the revised rate coming into effect from July 1, 2026.
 The increased DA will be paid along with the November salary, providing financial relief to lakhs of employees ahead of Diwali.
Also read | Qcomm burns brighter as Diwali sees key shift in buyer behaviour 
According to the announcement, the revised DA will benefit state government employees, employees of aided educational institutions, technical educational institutions and urban local bodies across Uttar Pradesh.
The government has also decided to credit the arrears for the period from July to October 2026 into the employees' provident fund accounts.
 Live Events
 With the revision, the DA rate for eligible employees will increase to 63 per cent. The revised allowance will be reflected in the November salary, while the arrears for the preceding four months will be deposited separately into their provident fund accounts.
 The announcement comes ahead of Diwali, with the revised allowance set to benefit a large section of the state's workforce.
 Earlier, CM Yogi gave appointment letters to 4,543 newly selected Sub-Inspectors and Platoon Commanders in Lucknow.
Also read | EPFO primes itself for life after wage ceiling hike 
"Under the 'Mission Rozgar', appointment letters were handed over today in Lucknow to 4,543 newly selected Sub-Inspectors and Platoon Commanders in @Uppolice
through a fair and transparent recruitment process. I assure you that in the double-engine government, the chain of providing appointment letters to the youth of UP will continue relentlessly without stopping, without faltering," he wrote on X.
